# AS-EXT-001A fixture provenance

Frozen fixtures for directive D-PROJECT-ATLAS-KIMI-AS-EXT-001A-001 §9.
Real fixtures are byte-exact captures from EXP-ATLAS-SELFHOST-BASELINE-001
(base commit `6d874751d3ed9cb05433a8d50ab372a997418d84`; curation contract
`FIXTURE-CURATION-P0-C.md`, F-01…F-08). Full-file SHA-256 values were
re-verified at materialization time against the staged corpus
(`D:\atlas-selfhost\baseline-6d87475\corpus\`) or git history. Synthetic
fixtures are authored new; each carries its rationale below. Fixture files
must be treated as immutable: any correction lands as a new fixture plus a
provenance amendment, never an in-place rewrite.
